hero.title: Video subtitles, made simpler with AI

workflow.title: Three steps to finished subtitles
workflow.description: A simple flow for quickly processing and editing video subtitles.
workflow.step1Text: Paste the Google Drive link for the video you want to process.
workflow.step2Text: Transcribe speech and translate it into the project language.
workflow.step3Text: Review cues, adjust timing, then export SRT, VTT, or TXT.

capabilities.aiText: LTS.ai turns audio into subtitles, translates to the project language, and shows clear progress while it works.
capabilities.editorText: Watch the video, compare source and translation, adjust timing, then export SRT, VTT, or TXT.
